notes: Merch workspace: a big live mockup now sits beside the canvas while you design. Drag its edge to resize, or hide it.
Animations can now be saved as GIF, full-colour animated PNG, or video (MP4 / WebM) for social posts.
Ad Studio walks you through Theme, Campaign, Voice and Style as numbered steps with Next buttons.
The right-hand tabs stay on one row, and Layers takes less room by default.
File > Fonts used in this design lists every font, ready to copy for print hand-offs.
Library shapes now match drawn shapes exactly.
A shape you pick stays armed after each draw (V returns to Move), and Rounded rectangle is gone from the shape menu - use Radius in Design.
Picking a shape low in the list no longer closes the Filled / Outline choice - it now opens right under the pointer.
